profile: Formed in Kraków, Poland in August 2023, Sighs Of Death is a death metal band with a twist. Their sound fuses traditional death metal brutality with the rhythmic pulse of groove, creating a potent and distinctive musical cocktail. The lyrics take a deep dive into the world of emotions and the pressing issues of our time, making Sighs Of Death not just a band, but a voice for change.
